acceptance_criteria: The host-only readiness command scans Rust/C/C++ sources and recognized manifests without building, executing, installing, or launching the inspected project.
The versioned report distinguishes detected evidence from unverified dependencies, framework coverage, and target behavior and contains no compatibility certification.
Focused tests cover portable Rust, filesystem/process calls, C process/thread calls, C++ GUI-framework evidence, unknown dependencies, malformed roots, and stable JSON output.
A separate host-buildable portable-files sample reuses an appropriately noticed portable Nagi Files source unit and uses the existing package validator.
English and Japanese guides describe source reuse, OS/capability adapters, public SDK boundaries, Permission/Capability constraints, and unverified areas.
The workstream registry/state validate, owned paths match the exact allowlist, and no active Hello Nagi, app-sdk-contract, or multiarch files are modified.
Nagi 0.1 M30 and all guest/runtime acceptance remain unchanged and NOT_RUN for this checkpoint.
deferred: Linux binary compatibility, blanket POSIX compatibility, Qt/GTK/Electron/SDL compatibility, and other framework coverage without per-target evidence.
Nagi target ABI details, migration effort estimates, production Files capability adapters, guest installation, launch, and runtime acceptance until their gates are open.
